key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:0:0280
name: acquire_pair_with_rollback
description: Library code that calls one helper, then passes its result and the other arguments to a second helper. If that second call fails, it releases the first result and returns zero. The helpers are unnamed, so only the call pattern is known.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0000
name: load_icon_header_into_structure
description: Library code that asks a helper to read an icon header into a stack buffer, then copies its ten longwords and several further fields into the structure it was given. If a link field in that structure is set, it stores the structure in the record that field points to.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:004A
name: copy_stack_frame_into_structure
description: Library code, entered partway through a routine, that copies ten longwords and several other fields from a stack frame into the structure held in an address register. It is the write-back half of the header load in the routine before it.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:009C
name: return_zero_stub
description: The routine does no work and immediately returns zero. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library on the disk.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:00A8
name: copy_icon_fields_to_stack
description: Library code that copies ten longwords and several other fields from the structure it is given into a local stack buffer, sets two leading words in that buffer, and then calls a second routine with the first two arguments and a pointer to the buffer.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0124
name: read_info_file_icon_data
description: Library code that appends the info extension to a supplied name, opens that file and reads a 78-byte icon header. It checks a signature word and a version word, then reads further fields and allocates a longword table when one is needed.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0180
name: read_icon_fields_from_file
description: Library code that continues an icon file read: it checks the header signature and version, clears two fields, optionally allocates a buffer, then reads several fields in order. It fills a longword table four bytes at a time while the remaining count exceeds four.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:024A
name: read_icon_optional_tables
description: Library code that reads two values from the file and then, for each optional structure field that is still unset, allocates and fills a longword table. It returns one on success and zero when any read or allocation fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:033A
name: read_icon_longword_list
description: Library code that reads longwords from the file in a loop, storing each into an array and reducing the remaining byte count by four per pass until four or fewer bytes remain. It then checks one more structure field and returns one on success or zero on failure.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:03EE
name: call_helper_return_zero
description: Calls one helper for its side effect and returns zero whatever that helper reports. It is a thin wrapper in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:03F2
name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:03FE
name: write_info_file_icon
description: Allocates a 260-byte path buffer, appends the info extension to a supplied name, and opens that file in new-file mode. It then writes a 78-byte icon header followed by optional fields, and reports an error code and returns zero if the allocation fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:043E
name: write_icon_fields_to_file
description: Continues the icon file write by sending the header's remaining fields to the open file, with a check on each optional structure field before it is written. It returns one when every write succeeds and zero on the first failure.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:04F2
name: write_optional_icon_lists
description: Writes an optional item from the structure, then sizes a null-terminated list of pointers by adding four bytes for each entry and writes that total. It returns one on success and zero when any write fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0584
name: write_icon_list_entries
description: Walks a null-terminated pointer list, writing the measured length and contents of each entry, then handles one more optional pointer field. It returns one when every write succeeds and zero otherwise.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:05AC
name: write_icon_pointer_table
description: Writes each entry of a null-terminated pointer table, storing the measured length before its contents, then writes one further optional field. It restores two saved structure values before it returns.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0656
name: visit_list_nodes_until_end
description: Walks a list of nodes from the one after the given header, calling a helper on each node until the next pointer is zero or the list's end pointer is reached. It then calls the helper once more on the last node found.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0662
name: visit_node_chain_until_end
description: Follows a chain of linked nodes by calling a helper to fetch each next pointer, and calls another helper on each node. It stops when the next pointer is zero or the chain returns to its base, then calls a final helper on the last node if one was found.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0692
name: call_helper_at_next_offset
description: Calls the same helper with the first argument unchanged and the second argument increased by 140, then returns. It is a thin forwarding step in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:06A8
name: allocate_icon_record_block
description: Allocates a cleared 168-byte block, sets a field inside it, and calls a helper with the caller's argument. If that call fails it releases the block and returns zero; otherwise it passes the block to a second helper and returns it on success.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:06F6
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper and returns without a value. It is a thin wrapper in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0714
name: return_zero_stub
description: The routine does no work and immediately returns zero. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:071C
name: store_pair_in_table_entry
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a buffer record, flushing through a helper when the counter runs out, then stores two values into consecutive entries of a table at the counter's index. It returns one on success and zero if the flush helper fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0744
name: store_pair_after_decrement
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter behind a pointer and stores two values into the table entry that counter indexes, then returns one. It is the tail of the routine before it, used when no flush is needed.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0768
name: allocate_cleared_icon_buffer
description: Allocates a cleared 94-byte block, sets a field inside it, and calls a helper with the caller's argument. If a helper call fails it releases the block and returns zero; otherwise it passes the block to a second helper and returns it.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:07E2
name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:07E4
name: call_library_return_zero
description: Calls one library routine through the library stub and returns zero whatever it reports. It is a thin wrapper in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:07FC
name: advance_and_call_helper
description: Calls the same helper with the first argument unchanged and the second argument increased by 78, the same size used for the icon header reads, then returns. It steps a pointer forward by one header.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0818
name: find_tooltype_value
description: Searches a null-terminated list of names, testing each with a helper against the supplied text, and returns a pointer to the text just after the equals sign in the match. It returns zero when no entry matches.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0836
name: scan_list_for_key_value
description: Walks a null-terminated list of entries, calling a helper on each, and returns a pointer just past the equals sign of the first entry that matches. It returns zero when the list ends without a match.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0856
name: find_value_in_entry_list
description: Walks a null-terminated list of names, calling a helper on each, and returns a pointer just past the equals sign of the first entry that passes the check. It returns zero when the list ends without a match.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0864
name: match_separated_segment
description: Walks a string whose segments are separated by the character with code 124, using a helper to find each separator. It compares each segment's length with a given length and, on a length match, checks the segment contents; it returns one on a match and zero at the end of the string.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:087E
name: search_separated_segments
description: Steps through a string split by the character with code 124, measuring each segment and calling helpers to confirm a match. It returns one when a segment of the expected length matches and zero when the string runs out.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0896
name: scan_separated_segments_for_match
description: Scans a string divided by the separator with code 124, finding each segment's end and comparing its length with the expected value. It calls a helper to confirm a length match and returns one when the check passes, or zero when no segment remains.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:08BE
name: step_to_matching_segment
description: Advances from one separator to the next, measuring each segment and checking its length against the expected value and a helper's result. It returns one when a matching segment is found, and it does not return a value otherwise.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:08C8
name: scan_segments_from_start
description: Starts at the first segment of a separated string, measuring each segment and comparing it with an expected length. It returns one when a segment matches and zero when it reaches the end of the string.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:08D6
name: parse_copy_prefix_name
description: Clears a flag byte in a name record, then checks whether the supplied text begins with the word copy. If it does not, the whole text is copied into the record's 30-byte name field; if it does, the copy number and the remaining name are read and stored.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0926
name: validate_copy_number_field
description: Checks for a three-character marker after the fifth character of the text, then reads a decimal number and requires a four-character marker to follow it. It is the validation step of the copy-name parser.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0948
name: parse_decimal_count_marker
description: Reads a run of decimal digits from the text into a number and, when that number is nonzero, checks that a four-character marker follows. It is a shared helper for the copy-number parser.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:094C
name: parse_decimal_copy_count
description: Reads decimal digits from the text into a count, stepping past each digit, and checks that a four-character marker follows a nonzero count. The copy-label format appears among its referenced strings.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:09BE
name: convert_decimal_digit
description: Returns the numeric value of a character when its code lies in the range for the digits zero to nine, and minus one for any other character.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:3:09D6
name: return_minus_one_stub
description: The routine does no work and returns a constant minus one. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:1:0000
name: acquire_pair_with_rollback
description: Calls one helper, then passes its result and the other arguments to a second helper; if that second call fails it releases the first result and returns zero. The code is the same as the earlier pair routine, so it is a second copy of that pattern.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:1:004E
name: allocate_cleared_record_with_count
description: Allocates a cleared 96-byte record, stores ten in its count field and in the caller's word, and passes the record to a helper that fills the caller's buffer. It returns true when the allocation succeeded and false otherwise.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:1:008A
name: return_zero_stub
description: The routine does no work and immediately returns zero. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:1:0092
name: check_helper_result_matches
description: Calls a helper with three arguments and returns its result when that result equals the last argument, or zero otherwise. It is a check wrapper in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:1:00BC
name: check_result_against_argument
description: Calls a helper with three arguments and returns its result only when it equals the last argument, returning zero for any other result. It has the same shape as the check wrapper before it, with a different helper.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:1:00E2
name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:6:0000
name: divide_unsigned_longword
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit value by a divisor, using sixteen shift-and-subtract steps when the divisor is wider than 16 bits, or direct division of each half otherwise. It returns the quotient and remainder together, and it sits in a gap of the library code.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:6:0020
name: run_sixteen_division_steps
description: Runs sixteen shift-and-subtract steps on a 32-bit value, moving bits through the carry flag and subtracting the divisor from the high half whenever it reaches it. It is the core loop of the division routine before it, and its result is not returned.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:6:0040
name: multiply_longwords_partial
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products and combines them into a 32-bit result, returning that product with a swapped copy of the second operand.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:6:00C8
name: call_raw_format_vector
description: Calls the Amiga operating system's formatted-output routine through its library vector, then returns. The arguments are supplied by the code around it.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:0000
name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a null-terminated string by counting down from minus one until the terminator, and returns that count as the string length.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:0010
name: find_character_in_string
description: Returns a pointer to the first occurrence of the given character in a null-terminated string, or zero if the character is not present before the terminator.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:0026
name: return_zero_stub
description: The routine does no work and immediately returns zero. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:002C
name: copy_c_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination until the zero terminator has been copied, advancing both pointers on each byte. It returns nothing.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:0038
name: append_c_string
description: Moves to the terminator of the destination string, then copies the source string onto its end, including the terminating zero. It returns nothing.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:0048
name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares up to a given number of characters of two strings. It returns one when a character differs and zero when the strings match through the terminator or the count is used up.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:0064
name: return_one_stub
description: The routine does no work and immediately returns one. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:006C
name: walk_string_with_limit
description: Walks a string for at most the given number of characters, and when it reaches the terminator it calls a helper and returns. It reports no value and does not change the string.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:0080
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper and returns without a value. It is a thin wrapper in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:0092
name: copy_string_zero_padded
description: Copies a source string into a fixed-size buffer, stopping at the terminator and then zero-filling the rest of the buffer up to the given length. It writes nothing when the length is not positive.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:5:00A2
name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:7:0000
name: initialise_list_header
description: Initialises a list header so that it is empty: its head points at the tail slot, its tail is cleared, and its tail-predecessor points back at the head. It is the standard setup for an empty list.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:2:0000
name: process_icon_record
description: Returns one for a null record. Otherwise it calls a helper with the value 20 and, if that succeeds, calls a second helper and passes the record's field at offset 10 to a third helper, returning that result. It returns zero when the first helper fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:2:007A
name: process_record_list
description: Walks a linked list of records, calling a helper with the value 16 on each and then a second helper with a pointer field and a length taken from a byte field multiplied by four. It returns one when the list ends and zero as soon as a step fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:2:008C
name: process_record_chain_pairs
description: Follows a chain of records through the next pointer, calling two helpers on each record. It returns one when the chain is exhausted and zero as soon as either helper fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:2:00D4
name: return_zero_stub

name: allocate_checked_record
description: When the flag argument is nonzero, allocates a cleared 20-byte record, checks the second argument with a helper, stores a value from a second helper in the record, and passes it to a third helper. It returns the record on success, minus one on failure, and zero when the flag is zero.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:2:01A4
name: return_minus_one_stub
description: The routine does no work and returns a constant minus one. It is an empty stub in the shared icon.library.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:2:01AC
name: build_record_list
description: Builds a linked list of 16-byte records, allocating each one with a helper and linking it to the previous record. For each record it reads a size from a byte field, allocates a buffer of that size and stores the buffer pointer. It returns the first record, or minus one when an allocation or helper call fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:2:01C2
name: link_record_buffers
description: Continues the record-building loop by allocating each record, linking it to the previous one, reading a size byte and allocating a buffer for it. It returns the first record, or minus one when a step fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:libs/icon.library:2:01EC
name: fill_record_list_links
description: Stores the link for each record in the list, then reads the next record and allocates its buffer until the chain ends. It returns the first record, or minus one when a helper call fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub

name: start_iconx_program
description: Program entry of the IconX executable. It allocates a state record, looks up the running task and opens the DOS library, returning an error code of 20 or 100 when one of those steps fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:0:01A0
name: release_iconx_resources
description: Stores a value in the task's state slot, then runs the cleanup steps whose pointers are set. Those steps close files and libraries, free memory and reply to a message, and the routine returns the value it was given.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:0000
name: open_iconx_console_window
description: Prints that the program is used from Workbench only when it is started that way, and otherwise opens a console window described by the specification CON:0/50/640/80/IconX. It reports a not-enough-memory message when allocation fails.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:021C
name: process_iconx_request_line
description: Prepares a command buffer, looks up a handler and checks whether the result is a single dot-prefixed character. If so, it builds the command and then issues either a WAIT command for 999 minutes or an endcli command, depending on the flags and on success.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:0382
name: initialise_icon_library
description: Initialises a library descriptor by passing its first field to a helper. If a second helper returns a value, it makes the library, creates its function table and enables the new functions, then returns the result of the first step.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:03DE
name: join_path_entries
description: Allocates a 260-byte buffer and joins the names of a linked list into one path, inserting a separator before each name once the buffer holds text. Entries whose first character is printable are appended, and the RAM: prefix is among the referenced strings.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:050E
name: concatenate_strings_into_buffer
description: Copies one string into a buffer, appends a second string after it, and passes the position after the combined text to a helper. The length of the second string is also used in the position arithmetic. It returns nothing.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:0554
name: count_string_length
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string by stepping through it one byte at a time until the terminator, and returns that count.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:0564
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination one at a time, including the terminating zero. It returns nothing.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:0574
name: advance_to_terminator_then_call
description: Advances a pointer to the zero terminator of a string, then calls a helper with that position and the unchanged second argument. It returns nothing.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:2:0590
name: parse_signed_decimal
description: Parses a signed decimal integer from a string, skipping an optional plus or minus sign and accumulating digits until a non-digit is reached. It returns the value, negated when a minus sign was present.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:5:0000
name: forward_with_stack_slot
description: Calls another routine with the two arguments it received and a pointer to a local stack slot, then returns. It is a thin forwarding wrapper in the IconX program.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:9:0000
name: forward_library_call_no_args
description: Calls a function through a library vector at a fixed offset, passing no arguments of its own, then returns. It is a thin wrapper in the IconX program.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:9:0018
name: invoke_library_entry_no_args
description: Calls a function through a different library vector at a fixed offset, passing no arguments of its own, then returns. It is a thin wrapper in the IconX program.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:4:0000
name: format_message_then_output
description: Formats its argument into a 140-byte stack buffer through the operating system's formatted-output routine, measures the resulting text, and passes the buffer and its length to a helper when the text is not empty. It returns nothing.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:4:004C
name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register through the address register, a single-byte store used as a helper in the IconX program. It returns nothing.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:4:0050
name: call_raw_format_no_args
description: Calls the operating system's formatted-output routine through its library vector, passing no arguments of its own, then returns. It is a thin wrapper in the IconX program.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:IconX:4:0074
name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register through the address register and returns. It is a single-byte store in the IconX program, the same form as the store before it.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: check_boot_library_call
description: Boot block code that calls a library function and returns minus one when it reports failure, or zero otherwise. It is the first step of the boot block.

key: secret of monkey island, the (1990)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 4)[cr skr][a2]/Secret of Monkey Island, The (1990)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 4)[cr SKR][a2].adf:bootblock:0:0032
name: decode_boot_region_bytes
description: Adds and XORs 850 bytes of memory with values taken from a library call and a global variable. Later bytes of the region decode as bad instruction data, so only this byte-transform loop is recovered.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: The routine does no work and returns minus one. It is a stub in the runtime segment that the reference run executed.

name: call_conditional_library_entry
description: Calls a routine, then, when its flag result is clear, calls a second routine and a library function through a global vector. It finishes by calling a third routine and returns nothing.

name: open_dos_library
description: Opens dos.library through the operating system's OldOpenLibrary call and stores the returned library handle in a global variable.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decompiler output for this region is mostly bad instruction data, so only fragments are recovered: two bytes are adjusted in memory and a word is copied between addresses. It is not a complete routine.

key: mortal kombat ii (1994)(acclaim)[cr psg](disk 1 of 4)[a3]/Mortal Kombat II (1994)(Acclaim)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 4)[a3].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: read_boot_track_and_run
description: Boot block code that allocates memory through a helper and, if that succeeds, fills an I/O request with a 4608-byte transfer at offset 1024 and sends it with DoIO until a flag clears. It then calls Forbid and SuperState, calls the code it allocated, and returns that result.

key: mortal kombat ii (1994)(acclaim)[cr psg](disk 1 of 4)[a3]/Mortal Kombat II (1994)(Acclaim)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 4)[a3].adf:bootblock:0:006C
name: load_fixed_boot_memory_block
description: Boot block code that allocates memory at a fixed address through a helper and, when that succeeds, fills an I/O request with fixed values and sends it with DoIO. It clears a global before a further call, touches the background colour register, and always returns the constant 4608.

key: Mortal Kombat II (1994)(Acclaim)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 4)[a3].adf boot-block load +$C7800 to $060000 (18944 bytes):0:00D2
name: choose_halved_or_input_word
description: Returns half of a second word when a mode argument equals one, and otherwise returns the input word unchanged.

key: Mortal Kombat II (1994)(Acclaim)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 4)[a3].adf boot-block load +$C7800 to $060000 (18944 bytes):0:00EA
name: mask_word_from_table
description: Doubles an index, reads a word from a fixed table held in memory, and returns it ANDed with the other word. It is a table-lookup mask.

name: return_first_stack_value
description: Returns the first value passed on the stack and does no other work. It is a fragment in a gap of the code.

name: poll_buttons_and_set_dma
description: Reads the fire-button and disk status port and the right and middle mouse buttons, updates a state flag byte, and writes display-window, sprite and DMA control registers. It calls helpers when a condition is met and saves several registers around those calls.

name: clear_global_flag_bits
description: Clears two bit masks in a global variable with bitwise AND operations, then returns.

name: copy_state_block_if_pending
description: Calls a helper, then when its flag result is clear, copies a 64-longword block into a second area if a pending word is set, and sets a global to a fixed value. It returns the helper's value.

name: run_dma_setup_steps
description: Calls five helpers, which reach the DMA control register, and then sets a global value to fifteen. It returns nothing.

name: encode_state_tag_three
description: Calls a helper, then when its flag result is clear returns the global value in the high byte with a low-byte tag of three. Otherwise it clears the global and returns nothing.

name: encode_state_tag_two
description: Calls a helper, then when its flag result is clear returns the global value in the high byte with a low-byte tag of two. Otherwise it clears the global and returns nothing.

name: wait_then_clear_pending_flag
description: Calls a helper, then busy-waits until a flag global becomes zero, and clears the state global. It returns nothing.

name: call_then_set_flag_bit
description: Calls one helper, then sets one bit in a global flag variable and returns.

name: store_flag_words_set_bits
description: Stores two input words into a global variable when a pending flag is clear, calling a helper and writing a derived byte if a bit is not set. It then sets a further bit in the global on every path.

name: check_global_slot_sentinels
description: Checks four consecutive slots in a global block against a sentinel value of minus one, calling a helper for each slot that is not the sentinel. It returns the pair of inputs unchanged.

name: call_helper_and_return_pair
description: Calls one helper and returns its input pair unchanged.

name: load_signed_block_and_relocate
description: Copies a 64-longword block into a global area, then checks its first longword against a four-character signature. When it matches, it records the block's position and adds that position to three of its offset fields.

name: step_table_driven_decoder
description: Decrements a countdown global and, when it expires, resets it to six and returns. Otherwise it walks a table of pointers until it finds an entry with a nonzero first word, then decodes from that entry. The routine is long, so only these opening steps are recovered.

name: reset_state_bit_one
description: Clears one 16-bit word, then writes one and then 255 to the global. It is one of four similar entry points, one for each bit value.

name: reset_state_bit_two
description: Clears one 16-bit word, then writes two and then 255 to the global. It is one of four similar entry points, one for each bit value.

name: reset_state_bit_four
description: Clears one 16-bit word, then writes four and then 255 to the global. It is one of four similar entry points, one for each bit value.

name: reset_state_bit_eight
description: Clears one 16-bit word, then writes eight and then 255 to the global. It is one of four similar entry points, one for each bit value.

name: update_audio_channel_state
description: Updates one audio channel: it compares a period value with the channel descriptor, sets state flags, and writes to the audio period, DMA control and interrupt enable registers. An early return skips the update when a sentinel value matches.

name: set_state_and_mask_byte
description: Sets a global state value to six and returns the input byte ORed with 254, which sets every bit except the lowest.

name: process_audio_channel_table
description: Walks a table of audio channel descriptors, sending period and location values to the audio channel registers and DMA control. A countdown global is decremented on each entry, and the input value is returned when the countdown reaches zero.

name: enable_dma_channel_one
description: Clears one 16-bit word, then writes one and then 255 to the global, and returns the input byte. The DMA control register is among the hardware registers listed for it.

name: enable_dma_channel_two
description: Clears one 16-bit word, then writes two and then 255 to the global. The DMA control register is among the hardware registers listed for it.

name: enable_dma_channel_four
description: Clears one 16-bit word, then writes four and then 255 to the global. The DMA control register is among the hardware registers listed for it.

name: enable_dma_channel_eight
description: Clears one 16-bit word, then writes eight and then 255 to the global. The DMA control register is among the hardware registers listed for it.

name: copy_state_block_and_reset
description: Copies a 64-longword block from a global area into a second area when a pending flag is set, then sets a global from a series of sentinel checks and stores a fixed value. Its listed registers include the DMA and interrupt control registers.

name: return_byte_unchanged
description: Returns the input byte without change. It is a pass-through used by several callers.

name: scan_global_sentinel_slots
description: Calls helpers over a block of four global slots, checking each slot against a sentinel value of minus one and calling a helper for each slot that is set. It returns a value that carries the input pair with a fixed high-bit tag.

name: save_registers_to_state_area
description: When a flag is set, calls a helper and then saves the caller's data and address register values into a fixed memory area, recording a routine pointer there as well. It returns nothing when the flag is clear.

name: advance_audio_sequencer_step
description: Advances an audio sequence counter, and when it reaches its limit reloads the next sequence entry and handles a repeat count. It writes the channel 0 location register when a sample pointer is loaded and returns a value from the sequence state.

name: run_audio_sequence_commands
description: Interprets audio sequence commands: the low four bits of each command select a case in a switch, and the cases adjust a value within fixed limits and move between sequence pointers. Only part of this decoded routine is recovered.

name: advance_audio_channel_loop
description: Steps through audio channel buffers, moving a pointer by a stride on each sample count and returning when the count runs out and the channel's wait counter has ended.

name: process_audio_channel_commands
description: Processes one audio channel: while its wait counter is zero, it reads the next command word from the channel's sequence and stores the values in the channel record. It stops once a wait count is set.

name: service_audio_interrupt
description: Services the audio interrupt: when its pending flag is set it clears the flag, runs the channel update steps, and touches the interrupt enable and beam position registers before finishing.

name: update_audio_hardware_registers
description: Writes selected words from global state into the audio channel registers at a fixed hardware address, and updates running minimum values kept in memory. It then calls two helpers.

name: start_audio_channel_three
description: Negates a word, sets the state variables for channel three, writes its volume register, and sets the DMA and interrupt enable controls. It returns the input byte with its two lowest bits set.

name: clear_sample_state_on_flag
description: When a pending flag is set, clears a counter and a status word, then stores the input word in a state slot. Otherwise it returns without changing anything.

name: check_audio_sample_status
description: Checks the current entry of an audio sample table: a minus-one entry marks the sample as ready, while another entry that is not the terminator triggers a load helper and a counter increment. Otherwise it advances the position index.

name: load_audio_sample_channel_three
description: Copies a block of words into the channel three sample buffer, then sets that channel's location, length, period and volume registers. DMA and interrupt enable controls are set alongside, and the routine returns nothing.

name: fill_sixteen_words_with_value
description: Writes the value in the data register into sixteen consecutive words starting at a fixed memory address.

name: poll_with_helper_calls
description: Calls one helper, then repeats a second helper call in a loop whose exit condition is fixed before the loop starts. It is a polling wait in the runtime segment.

name: poll_until_zero_flag_set
description: Calls a helper, then keeps calling a second helper until the zero flag from the first call is set. It returns nothing.

name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. It is an empty stub in the runtime segment.

name: wait_and_store_result
description: Waits while bit zero of a global is set, calls a helper, stores its result and two extra register values into a memory record, and then sets bit zero. It returns nothing.

name: return_without_work
description: Assigns the global variable to itself, which changes nothing, and returns.

name: decompress_packed_block_colours
description: Decodes a packed block by reading bits from words in a loop, writing the decoded values into memory and updating the background colour register. Only the start of the decoder is recovered here.

name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. It is an empty stub in the runtime segment.

name: clear_flag_and_run_steps
description: Clears bit five of a global flag, runs two helper steps in loops, then ORs the global with itself and calls a further helper. The code shows only these helper calls and no other work.

name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. It is an empty stub in the runtime segment.

name: call_helper_return_stored_value
description: Calls one helper and then returns a stored value from a global slot.

name: map_mode_code_and_poll
description: Maps three specific mode codes to replacement codes, looks up an entry in a table indexed by the low byte of the code, and calls a helper in a loop until that entry is zero. It returns nothing.

name: store_word_pair_if_changed
description: Compares the input word with a stored value and returns unchanged when they match. Otherwise it writes the word and a zero into a two-word record and calls a helper.

name: retry_until_signature_matches
description: Repeatedly calls a helper, checks a signature word and a stored pointer after each call, and increments a counter until both match. It then returns.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper and returns without a value. It is a thin wrapper in the runtime segment.

name: forward_to_helper
description: Calls one helper and returns, passing nothing of its own. It is a thin forwarding step in the runtime segment.

name: configure_disk_sync_registers
description: When a flag is set, writes the disk sync word and the ADK control word to their hardware registers. It then calls helpers and stores a byte derived by dividing an input value by a fixed constant. The registers listed for it are the disk sync and ADK control registers.

name: write_sentinel_around_byte
description: Calls a helper, then writes a sentinel byte of 255, the input byte, and 255 again to the memory location held in the address register. It returns nothing.

name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. A CIA port register is listed for it, but the code makes no access to it.

name: wait_status_bit_or_error
description: Clears one control bit selected by a value, waits for a status bit to be set, and returns zero when it appears. It returns a negative error code when a status check fails or the wait is not met.

name: pulse_control_bit_with_delay
description: Clears two bits in a control byte, calls a helper, sets bit zero, and then runs a delay loop of 91 helper calls. It returns nothing.

name: toggle_control_bits_and_delay
description: Sets bit one and clears bit zero in a control byte, calls a helper, sets bit zero, and then runs a delay loop of 91 helper calls. It returns nothing.

name: spin_on_self_comparison
description: Spins on a byte comparison that always holds, so the loop never ends on its own. Only this loop structure is recovered, reading a byte at a fixed offset from a base pointer.

name: poll_status_and_align_bits
description: Waits while a status bit is set, reads a byte through a helper, and updates a control byte based on one bit of it. It then repeatedly calls a helper and steps two values until their bit fields match.

name: run_hardware_copy_loop
description: Loops over a counted set of blocks, writing control words to hardware registers and calling helpers for each block. It checks a counter after each pass and returns when the counter reaches zero or a timeout count runs out.

name: combine_masked_values
description: Masks an input value and a value read through a pointer with a global mask, doubles the second masked value, and returns the sum of the two.

name: xor_block_words
description: XORs each word of a memory block into an accumulator, counting down through the block, and returns that accumulator masked with a second input.

name: copy_sized_blocks_with_retry
description: Splits a value into a block index and an offset within 512-byte blocks, then copies data for each block into a stack buffer. It retries a status wait up to four times and returns minus one when every retry fails.

name: interleave_bits_and_xor_words
description: Adds 28799 to a global variable, then walks three word streams, interleaving the even bits of two sources and XORing each result with the previous value before storing it. It returns the stacked argument.

name: unpack_compressed_data_block
description: Checks a four-byte header whose first three characters are RNC, then decompresses the block into a stack buffer by reading packed values. It copies blocks in reverse and calls helpers for table processing and conditional checks, and returns the decoded result.

name: find_bit_table_entry
description: Scans a table of word pairs until one pair matches a masked value, then reads a shift count and a mask byte from that entry to build a bit mask. It calls a helper when the comparison of the shift count fails.

name: mask_word_or_call_helper
description: Masks an input word with a second word, and when a byte comparison goes one way it calls a helper and returns that word instead. Otherwise it returns the masked word.

name: return_without_work
description: The routine is empty and contains no instructions that modify memory or registers. It returns at once.

name: read_four_bytes_into_longword
description: Reads four bytes from a pointer and combines them into one longword in big-endian order, with the first byte highest, and returns it.

name: build_bit_code_table
description: Reads a count and that many bytes from a source into a buffer, then builds a table of code entries by shifting bits and storing masks and offsets for each one. It calls a helper that masks a word and may call another routine.

name: run_status_loop_with_helpers
description: Sets a global to a fixed value, calls several helpers in sequence, and runs a loop that checks status globals and calls helpers until the status clears. The decompiled flow is partly bad instruction data, so only this structure is recovered.

name: save_and_restore_globals
description: Saves two global variables, sets them to zero and one for the helper calls in between, calls several helpers, and then restores both globals. It returns nothing.

name: decrement_global_if_bit_clear
description: When bit five of a global is clear, decrements that global. It returns the register values unchanged.

name: lookup_and_swap_table_word
description: Calls a helper to get an index, reads a 16-bit value from a fixed table at that index, and returns it with its two bytes swapped when the value is non-negative. Otherwise it stores and returns the constant 35463.

name: write_tagged_control_byte
description: Calls helpers according to the input value, computes a byte from a helper result plus a small offset in one case, and writes it to memory with the high bit set. It returns nothing.

name: fill_control_state_then_reset
description: Calls a helper, then runs a loop that writes values derived from two helper results, with the high bit set, into a global. The loop's exit test compares the global with itself. Afterwards the global is set to zero and then five.

name: initialise_global_flags
description: Sets a global to zero, calls two helpers, then sets the global to one. It returns nothing.

name: run_init_sequence_with_countdown
description: Calls a long sequence of helpers, clearing a global between steps, and then runs a countdown that stops at 60 while checking the sign of the global. The routine is long, so only this sequence is recovered.

name: run_setup_if_global_zero
description: Calls a helper with a routine pointer, then two more helpers, and when a global is zero it calls a further group of helpers. It returns nothing.

name: reset_global_state
description: Calls one helper, sets bits zero and one in a global, then overwrites the global with 255 and then zero. It returns nothing.

name: run_flag_gated_helpers
description: Calls three helpers, and when a global is zero it calls a further group of helpers. It returns nothing.

name: inspect_undecompiled_runtime_entry
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code exists for this routine. The facts show seven instructions in a runtime segment and a single call to one unnamed routine, and nothing more can be said from them.

name: adjust_global_then_clear
description: Calls one helper, decrements a global, and then sets it to zero. The decoded flow then ends in bad instruction data, so only these steps are recovered.

name: call_two_helpers
description: Calls two helpers and returns nothing. It is a thin wrapper in the runtime segment.

name: compute_signed_state_value
description: Returns a value from a routine, negated in one sign case, or one when a flag bit is set and the input is non-negative. Otherwise it returns the input unchanged.

name: compute_signed_state_alt_value
description: Returns a value from a routine, negated in one sign case, or two when a flag bit is set and the input is non-negative. Otherwise it returns the input unchanged.

name: return_without_work
description: The routine contains only a return, so it does nothing and ends at once. It is an empty stub in the runtime segment.

name: return_empty_routine
description: The routine is empty and performs no operations before it returns.

name: step_value_toward_target
description: Calls one routine, then moves a 16-bit global one step toward a target value, stopping on the target without overshooting. It returns nothing.

name: step_record_value_toward_target
description: Reads two 16-bit fields of a record, and when they differ moves the first one step toward the second without overshooting. It stores the result back in the record and returns nothing.

name: load_table_entry
description: Clears three global values, calls a routine to get an index, and loads the 16-bit table entry at that index into a global. It then calls a second routine and returns nothing.

name: return_global_capped_at_two
description: Returns the value of a global, or two when that value is greater than four.

name: load_longword_table_entry
description: Calls a routine to get an index, then stores the longword one position before that index in a table into a global. It returns nothing.

name: clear_global_flags
description: Sets a global to zero ten times in succession and returns zero.
